context_summary: F07 Front-end web dashboard — plan-feature (PLAN_ONLY, Architect only). The project has a fully functional REST API (F06) with 8 endpoints: cards list/detail/history, sets, market movers/stats, and collection triggers. All 385 tests pass at 96% coverage. The API uses cursor pagination, JSON envelope, CORS enabled (allow_origins=['*']), and OpenAPI docs. The front-end is the logical next step per the project roadmap (Future Planning Notes mention 'gerar script para o Lovable criar UI'). The user specifically wants a UI inspired by PokeBolsa (pokebolsa.com), which is a Pokemon card market intelligence platform with dashboard, search, price history, movers, and portfolio features. This is a PLAN_ONLY request — the Architect will decompose the front-end into tasks/waves without executing any code.

options_considered.description: Proceed with plan-feature (Architect only, PLAN_ONLY). Plan the front-end as a Vite+React SPA consuming the existing F06 REST API.
pros: F06 REST API is fully delivered and tested — the front-end has a stable backend to consume
CORS is already enabled with allow_origins=['*'] — no backend changes needed for dev
PLAN_ONLY mode is zero-risk — produces task files without code changes
The user's roadmap explicitly identifies front-end as the next phase
PokeBolsa provides clear UI inspiration with proven patterns for TCG market data
cons: Front-end introduces a new tech stack (React/Vite/TypeScript) — significant new dependencies
No front-end infrastructure exists yet — needs project scaffolding from scratch
Mono-repo approach (per roadmap) requires careful project structure to avoid conflicts

options_considered.description: Defer F07. Build authentication, rate limiting, or caching for the API first.
pros: Production-grade API features would benefit the front-end when it lands
cons: F06 PRD explicitly lists auth, rate limiting, and caching as non-goals for this phase
Front-end development can proceed in parallel with API hardening
The user explicitly requested the front-end as the next feature

rationale: F07 is the natural next step. The REST API (F06) is stable with 385 tests at 96% coverage, CORS enabled, and OpenAPI docs available. The user's roadmap explicitly calls for a front-end next, with PokeBolsa as UI inspiration. PLAN_ONLY mode allows the Architect to decompose a complex front-end feature into manageable waves before any code is written. The mono-repo approach (per the user's future planning notes) will be addressed in the task structure. Proceeding with Option A.
